era: [ ira + ṇa ] (thī,pu) CL=7 (Thī) (1) Water. (Pu) (2) One"s. Oneself.
eragū: [ era + gamu + rū ] (pu) CL=7 A typha grass.
eraka: [ i + rakaṇa.] (pu,na) CL=7 [(Thī) vi, pi,dhāna. Eraka (saṃ)] (1) Typha grass. (2) The wind that brings and blows well.
[ yādicchakanāma ] (pu) CL=7 (A thera, dragon, etc.,)  who is named Eraka.
erakaccha: [ yādicchakanāma ] (na) CL=7 The city is named Erakaccha.
erakacchanagara: [ erakaccha + nagara ] (thī,na) CL=7 The city is named Erakaccha.
erakadussa: [ eraka + dussa ] (na) CL=7 A robe that is made of typha grass fiber. A typha grass robe.
erakagumba: [ eraka + gumba ] (pu) CL=7 A typha grass bush. A typha grass forest.
erakamūla: [ ekara + mūla ] (na) CL=7 The root of a typha grass.
erakapatta: [ eraka + patta ] (na) CL=7 A leaf of typha grass. See - Erakagumba.
[ yādicchakanāma ] (ti) CL=7 (A dragon king) is named Erakapatta.
erakapattachindana: [ erakapatta + chindana ] (na) CL=7 Cuts the leaf of a typha grass.
erakatiṇa: [ eraka + tiṇa ] (na) CL=7 A typha grass. See - Eragū.
erakatiṇatūla: [ erakatiṇa + tūla ] (ti) CL=7 The silk cotton of the typha grass. Typha grass silk cotton.
erakatthera: [ eraka + thera ] (pu) CL=7 A thera is named Eraka.
erakatūla: [ eraka + tūla ] (ti) CL=7 The silk cotton of the typha grass. Typha grass silk cotton.
erakavana: [ eraka + vana ] (na) CL=7 A typha grass forest.
erakavatta: [ eraka + vatta ]  CL=9 Roll of skin- a set- which is like a kind of grass used for making coverlets. See erakavattika. See also Cammavaṭṭa.
erakavattakammakāraṇa: [ erakavatta + kammakāraṇa ] (thī,na) CL=7 The torture that is peeling out the skin of the body that is like peeling out the leaves of a typha grass. Torture or affliction that is peeling out the skin of the whole body (the skin covers the whole body from the head to the big toe that is like a typha grass that is covered with leaves until to the roots. See below.
erakavattika: [ erakavatta + ika ] (ti) CL=7 The torture that is peeling out the skin of the body that is like peeling out the leaves of a typha grass.
erakavāka: [ eraka + vāka ] (pu,na) CL=7 A typha grass fiber. See - Erakadussa.
erakavātayutta: [ erakavāta + yutta ] (ti) CL=7 Yoking with the wind that brings and blows well. (Yoking with the wind that blows the leaves of typha grass).
eraya: [ īra + ṇaya + hi ] (kri) CL=7 May you preach or teach. See - Erayati- (1).
erayantha: [ īra + ṇaya + anta ] (ti) CL=7 One who is a preacher.
erayati: [ īra + ṇaya + ti ] (kri) CL=7 (1) He preaches. (2) He scolds sharply.
eraye: [ īra + ṇaya + eyya ] (kri) CL=7 He should scold sharply. See - Erayati(2).
erayita: [ īra + ya + ta ] (ti) CL=7 Should be preached.
eraṇa: [ ira + yu ] (na) CL=7 Raise or lift. See below.
eraṇakkhama: [ eraṇa + khama ] (pu) CL=7 Suitable for lifting or raising.
eraṇḍaelaṇḍaeḷaṇḍa: [ eraḍi + ṇa.] (pu,na) CL=7 [Eraḍi hiṃsāyaṃ, vātaṃ eraṇḍatīti era-ṇḍo. Dhāna,ṭī.566. Eraṇḍati rogaṃ hiṃsatīti eraṇḍo. Kaccaññaḥ,nhā. 309. Īra+ḍa. Īrati kampatīti eraṇḍo. Moga,7.59. Eraṇḍa (saṃ)] A castor oil plant.
eraṇḍadaṇḍaka: [ eraṇḍa + daṇḍaka ] (pu) CL=7 The stalk of a castor oil plant.
eraṇḍaka: [ eraṇḍa + ka.] (pu) CL=7 [Dhāna,ṭī.566.] A castor oil plant. See below.
eraṇḍakaṭṭhi: [ eraṇḍaka + aṭṭhi ] (na) CL=7 A seed of a castor oil plant.
eraṇḍarukkha: [ eraṇḍa + rukkha ] (pu) CL=7 A castor oil plant.
eraṇḍarukkhadevatā: [ eraṇḍarukkha + devatā ] (thī) CL=7 A deva who is a guardian of a castor oil plant.
eraṇḍavana: [ eraṇḍa + vana ] (pu) CL=7 A castor oil plant forest.
eraṇḍavanamajjha: [ eraṇḍavana + majjha ] (na) CL=7 In the middle of the castor oil plant forest.
eresi: [ īra + ṇe + ī ] (kā,kri) CL=7 Agitated. See - Ereti.
ereti: [ īra + ṇe + ti.] (kā,kri) CL=7 [Nīti, dhā. 154.] (A) He caused to agitate. (B) He caused to move.
erisa: [ eta + disa(dusa) + kvi ] (ti) CL=7 Should be concentrated on and contemplated like this. See - Edikkha.
erita: [ īra + ta ] (na) CL=7 (1) Agitating. (Ti) (2) One who causes to agitate. (3) Agitating and can"t make a decision. (4) Should be permeated or scented.
eritasanti: [ erita + santi ] (thī) CL=7 The calmness of agitating. (The Micchā doctrine that causes to agitate).
erāpatha: [ erāpatha + ṇa.] (pu) CL=7 [Erāpatha (saṃ)] (A dragon king) is named Erāpatha.
erāpathanāgarājakula: [ erāpathanāgarāja + kula ] (na) CL=7 Erāpatha dragon king race.
erāvata: [ yādicchakanāma ] (pu) CL=7 The Erāvata elephant. An erāvata elephant who guards the east side. Erāvato puṇḍarīko. Dhāna. 30. (dhāna,ṭī,30.)
[ irāvatī + ṇa.] (pu) CL=7 [Erāvata (saṃ)] An orange Citrus aurantium (plant) with the red fruit. (toṅapoka, dhāna,ṭī,sya.). Mandarin orange. (dhāna,ṭī,sya.). A small-sized orange (plant).
erāvatī: [ yādicchakanāma.] (thī) CL=7 [Erāvatī (saṃ)]. A queen is named Erāvatī.
erāvaṇa: [ irāvaṇa + ṇa.] (pu) CL=7 [Irāvaṇo samuddo, tatra jāto erāvaṇo. Dhāna,ṭī. 22. Erāvaṇa (saṃ)] An elephant who lives and wanders in the ocean. A royal elephant of Sakka. An Erāvaṇa elephant. A male deva is named Erāvaṇa. (A male dava named Erāvaṇa who creates himself an elephant appearance that is the so-called erāvaṇa elephant.
erāvaṇakkhandhavaragata: [ erāvaṇakkhandhavara + gata ] (ti) CL=7 One who rides on the back of a royal erāvaṇa elephant.
erāvaṇanāmaka: [ erāvaṇa + nāma + ka ] (ti) CL=7 (A female deva) is named Erāvaṇa.
erāvaṇavāraṇa: [ erāvaṇa + vāraṇa ] (pu) CL=7 An erāvaṇa elephant.
erī: [ īra + ṇī ] (ti) CL=7 One who used to arise or happen. See - Era.
